name: deliverect
description: Ask about your restaurant's sales, orders, menus and opening hours across every location and ordering channel, using live data from Deliverect. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Deliverect connects restaurants and retailers to the delivery apps, web shops and kiosks their customers order from. This plugin lets you ask about your Deliverect account in plain language, using live data.

You can look up orders and their status, billing and product sales reports, best-selling products, stores and their opening hours, special hours, menus and the product catalog. It also shows what needs attention: paused or busy channels, failed orders, failed menu pushes, snoozed products, channel ratings and customer reviews.

Who it's for: restaurant owners, operators and managers who already use Deliverect.

Limitations: every tool is read-only, so nothing can change menus, prices, orders or opening hours. You see only what your Deliverect user can see in the Deliverect portal. Customer and courier personal details are never returned. Sign in with your Deliverect account; you accept the connector's terms the first time.
capabilities: Stores, opening hours and special hours
Channel status, failed menu pushes and snoozed products
defaultPrompt: Which products sold best this month?
Does anything on my Deliverect account need attention right now?
What are the holiday hours for my stores?

positive.prompt: Which products sold best on my Deliverect account in October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account and lists its top-selling products for October 2026 with quantities and revenue.

positive.prompt: Does anything on my Deliverect account need attention right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes current problems such as paused channels, failed orders or failed menu pushes, or says nothing needs attention.

positive.prompt: What are the opening hours of my stores?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each store of the test account with its opening hours per day.

positive.prompt: How much revenue did my account make in October 2026, per channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the order count and revenue for October 2026, broken down by ordering channel.

positive.prompt: Show me the categories on my menu and what's in the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Names a menu of the test account, lists its categories, and lists the products in the first category.

negative.prompt: Raise the price of every burger on my menu by 10%.

negative.description: Customer personal data is never returned
negative.prompt: Give me the phone numbers and addresses of the customers who ordered in October 2026.
Show me the sales of McDonald's on Deliverect.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to Deliverect sales, orders, stores, opening hours, menus, the product catalog and operational health.
